newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil car output rises 10.1 pct in Aug vs yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil car output rises 10.1 pct in Aug vs yr-ago.

text.p: Brazilian car output rose 10.1 percent to 174,906 in August from the 158,878 vehicles made in the same period last year, said a spokesman for Motor Manufactures Association (Anfavea).
Car output, however, dropped 0.2 percent last month from July figures, when 175,342 vehicles were produced, he said.
He noted domestic car sales increased 5.3 percent to 140,610 against 133,553 units sold in August 1995.
When compared to the 139,109 cars sold in July 1996, domestic car sales rose 1.1 percent.
Brazilian car manufacturers exported 29,234 units in August, up 1.5 percent against 28,799 vehicles sold in the international markets in the same month last year.
But exports fell 11.7 percent when compared to the 33,114 car exported in July 1996, he added.
